integrity: A symbolic finite-dimensional rank-one resolvent calculation and strict pair-transfer proof establish the all-size result. An exact standalone independent-matrix-inversion crosscheck covers finite examples only. Literature priority is uncertain beyond inspected sources.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted equal-size complete multipartite networks, \(r\ge3\) and \(n\ge2\), with \(1\le k<rn\) noise-free leaders and the unscaled grounded inverse trace; no claim for unequal part sizes, unequal conductances, noisy leaders or distinct performance criteria.
title: Exhaustive-community optimal leaders on balanced multipartite networks
